name: Thriller
description: Declarative thriller preset. Pursuit and countdown; no living-author imitation.
purpose: Keep the protagonist under a closing clock with reversible but costly choices.
writing_goals: Put a deadline or pursuit on the page early
Escalate capability of the opposing force
Force trade-offs between safety, truth, and loyalty
constraints: Do not imitate a living author
Use abstract narrative style, not a named living voice
A conspiracy that exists only as atmosphere
checklist: The clock or pursuit never fully stops
Antagonist capability does not shrink without cause
Public and private stakes remain distinct

pacing_tendency.value: short beats, frequent reversals, limited downtime

description_tendency.value: functional geography for chase and concealment
